response.sql: WITH groups AS (SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position), shares AS (SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM groups) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;
